note: The OLG fully covers FNS 821's requirement. The 'Citizenship Overview - SNAP' page states: 'Citizenship will be verified only when the information on the application is questionable' — directly mirroring FNS 821's verification trigger. The page provides an extensive list of acceptable verification documents (birth certificate, passport, naturalization certificate, military papers, court records, etc.), a self-declaration fallback under penalty of perjury when documents are unavailable, and the consequence for unverifiable citizenship: 'A member whose U.S. citizenship is questionable and cannot be verified will be ineligible and shall be disqualified on the basis of being an ineligible noncitizen.' The Cross-Program Mandatory Verifications page reinforces this: 'U.S. citizenship, although mandatory does not need to be verified unless it is questionable or the status has changed.' BEACON procedures for entering citizenship data are also documented on a separate page.
